fail_closed_rules: Sold Prior and Sold Post without consideration are not assigned prices.
Withdrawn Post is not represented as a completed sale or current availability.
Unreadable official update endpoints are not reconstructed or guessed.
Historic AST, lease and licence periods are not silently extended to current occupation.
Future or unresolved RPI, CPI and open-market reviews are not treated as current rent.
Seller top-ups remain separate from tenant-paid passing rent.
Projected index-linked rent is not substituted for auction-date passing rent.
Headline and tenancy-footnote conflicts are preserved without forced reconciliation.
Vacant shops, flats, offices and garages are not represented as income-producing occupation.
Planning and development potential are not represented as implemented or valued outcomes.
Peppercorn and nominal head rents remain separate from occupational income.
Active company status, charges and guarantees do not imply covenant strength or property-level performance.
Buyer administration charges and vendor-cost contributions remain separate from sale price.
Legal-pack EPC, title, update and restriction details are not filled by inference.
